title: Federal Bank Kochi Marathon 2027: participant essentials
description: Race categories, bib collection and participant rules for the Federal Bank Kochi Marathon 2027.
intro: The organizer’s 2027 information describes four distances and a pre-race expo. Some details on its website may be updated separately, so verify the latest event-day schedule and venue directly before booking travel.

entries.name: Pick one of four categories
entries.description: The organizer lists a full marathon, half marathon, 10 km and 3 km Green Run. Its FAQ says each participant may enter only one category. Check the category-specific details before registering.

entries.name: Check age requirements
entries.description: The FAQ lists age 18 for the marathon and half marathon. It lists 12 for the 10 km and 8 for the 3 km, with adult accompaniment for children below those respective ages; clarify the current conditions with the organizer.

entries.name: Collect your kit before race day
entries.description: The FAQ lists the bib expo for 12 and 13 February 2027 at Kochi Marriott Hotel in Edappally and says there will be no race-morning bib distribution. Recheck the published expo hours before you go.

entries.name: Arrange collection if you cannot attend
entries.description: The organizer says another person may collect your kit with a copy of the confirmation email or SMS and an accepted government identity document. Check the FAQ for its full list of accepted documents.

entries.name: Know which categories are timed
entries.description: The FAQ says timing chips are supplied for the marathon, half marathon and 10 km at the expo. It does not list the 3 km Green Run among chip-timed categories.

entries.name: Read transfer and cancellation rules
entries.description: The organizer’s FAQ says registrations can be transferred until two weeks before the event date. It generally excludes cancellation refunds, while noting limited exceptions at its discretion; contact the organizer about your circumstances.

entries.name: Check the current race venue and times
entries.description: The FAQ says venue details will be announced and points readers to event details for start times. Older information elsewhere on a site can relate to a previous edition, so confirm the 2027 schedule rather than relying on an old page.
